# RTA_: round trip / undo / redo / history audit of recently shipped objects (see the "RTA_" section at the end of smoke.sh).
# Generated by the recipe below; every case is: build -> read (pre) -> Undo -> read -> Redo -> read -> Save .3dm -> New -> Open ->
# read (post) -> for each exchange format: reopen the .3dm, Export the selection, New, Import it back, read.
# "read" = SelAll, Check, List, Volume, Area, BoundingBox, bracketed by unknown-command markers RTAB_<case>_<phase>.
# @TMP@ is replaced by smoke.sh.
